jobs.title: Director, CLM Enterprise Service
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Director, Enterprise CLM

Summary

McKesson is seeking a Director of Enterprise Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) to lead the delivery, optimization, and ongoing evolution of our enterprise CLM capabilities. This role will oversee how contracts are created, managed, digitized, stored, and integrated across the organization while partnering with business stakeholders to improve efficiency, compliance, and transparency across the contract lifecycle.

The Director will work closely with Legal, Procurement, Finance, IT, and business teams to drive adoption, enhance CLM processes, and deliver scalable solutions that support enterprise objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the execution and continuous improvement of McKesson's CLM roadmap and platform capabilities.
Manage end-to-end CLM processes, including contract intake, authoring, approvals, digitization, obligation management, and repository administration.
Partner with Legal, Finance, Procurement, IT, and business stakeholders to identify requirements and deliver CLM enhancements.
Establish and maintain standards for contract metadata, document digitization, and data quality.
Support CLM platform enhancements and integrations with ERP, CRM, sourcing, legal, and analytics systems.
Monitor operational metrics, service performance, and user adoption to drive continuous improvement.
Manage vendor relationships, program deliverables, and resource planning activities.
Ensure adherence to governance, security, compliance, and records management requirements.
Lead user adoption initiatives, change management efforts, and training programs.
Conduct post-implementation reviews and identify opportunities for workflow optimization.
Drive implementation of AI-enabled CLM capabilities, including metadata extraction, contract summarization, clause classification, and risk identification.
Partner with enterprise technology and AI teams to evaluate and deploy solutions that enhance contract management processes.

Minimum Requirements

Degree or equivalent experience. Typically requires 12+ years of professional experience and 4+ years of management experience.

Critical Skills

Experience leading CLM programs, contract management technology implementations, or related business process transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of CLM platforms, contract repositories, workflow automation, integrations, and contract data models.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders across multiple business functions.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Experience operating in large, matrixed organizations.
Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate business needs into scalable solutions.
Experience leveraging AI capabilities within contract management, legal operations, or enterprise workflow platforms.

Education / Certifications / Skills & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
8+ years of professional experience, including experience supporting CLM platforms, contract management technology, legal operations, or enterprise SaaS implementations.
Proven experience delivering CLM or related enterprise technology solutions (e.g., Conga CLM, Icertis, SAP, Salesforce, DocuSign, Pramata).
Experience leading cross-functional projects and business process improvement initiatives.
Strong understanding of contract management processes, governance practices, and enterprise system integrations.
Experience managing third-party vendors and implementation partners.
Preferred certifications in CLM, project management, or related disciplines.
Familiarity with AI technologies supporting document intelligence, OCR, workflow automation, or natural language processing.
Experience delivering AI-enabled contract digitization, classification, or analytics capabilities.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Experience with enterprise CLM platforms such as Conga, Icertis, Pramata, or similar solutions.
Knowledge of contract digitization, metadata management, and repository governance.
Experience within healthcare, pharmaceutical, distribution, or highly regulated industries.
Experience supporting integrations across ERP, CRM, procurement, legal, and analytics platforms.
Understanding of data governance, security, compliance, and records retention requirements.
PMP or related project/program management certification preferred.
Familiarity with responsible AI principles, model governance, and data quality practices.
Experience partnering with enterprise AI and data teams to deploy scalable business solutions.

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here.

Our Base Pay Range for this position

$126,900 - $169,200

jobs.title: Associate Director, Pricing Strategy
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

The Commercial Excellence Lead plays a pivotal role in elevating EY’s commercial performance across Canada’s most strategic and high value pursuits. With AI as a catalyst in the way professional services are delivered and priced it becomes it is important to continue to evolve the systems that support the firm in understanding market signals as well as adapting our support across all service lines.

As part of the Strategic Deals Team, this role will work closely with all service lines, account teams, engagement leaders, industry & sector groups to help consolidate market signals and shape pricing strategies, guiding pursuit teams through commercial decision making, and coaching teams to articulate EY Canada’s differentiated value in an increasingly AI first marketplace.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence complex internal and external stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities:

Shape and support the evolution of our pricing capabilities in Canada from consolidating market insights, to supporting pricing strategies and change management across our practices and teams.
Help establish EY Canada's pricing strategy for big deals/strategic pursuits, driving value-based pricing aligned with AI-enabled delivery, technology investment and evolving delivery model.
Collaborate with deal coaches and act as a pricing advisor in shaping commercial narratives
Guide account, engagement, and pursuit teams in pricing decisions, ensuring clarity between known vs. unknown AI related efficiencies and protecting margins while demonstrating value to clients.
Partner with all services lines and Clients & Industries teams to bring consistency to pricing models, commercial structures, negotiation strategies, and GTM narratives.
Partner with account, engagement, industry, sector leaders and teams to shape go-to-market strategy and articulate differentiated value propositions.
Enhance pursuit performance using data-driven insights, deal economics, and financial analysis to inform commercial decisions.
Foster commercial excellence across teams through coaching, collaboration with Global and Super Region Sales and Commercial Excellence teams and alignment with EY’s transformation and GTM priorities.
Create pricing insights tools that can be leveraged across the firm
Become an expert in all existing pricing tools (Regionally and Globally)
Train additional resources in pricing best practices, tools and technology
Develop a network across Super Regions to continually improve our pricing practices

Skills and attributes for success:

Minimum 8-12 years of experience in professional services, consulting, or strategic sales.
Experience in commercial activities, such as go-to-market strategy, pricing and sales
Strong analytical skills, financial analysis and forecasting, strategic thinking, and excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Understanding of engagement lifecycle management, risk assessment, and the ability to interact with senior management levels.
Experience working with senior stakeholders, specifically top team executives.
Strong facilitation, communication, and influencing skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

What We Offer

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories

At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with the highest ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

To all recruitment agencies: EY does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes submitted without a prior agreement or request from our hiring team will not be considered. EY is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Assistant Director, Digital Marketing - Client Engagement & Automation
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Winning isn’t just about the close. It’s about how organizations experience our differentiated value proposition at the beginning and across the middle that will ultimately define our future success as a professional services firm. Getting there means delivering meaningful touchpoints in the right ways and at the right time to create distinctly personal content and joined-up experiences for clients and potential clients that help answer the big questions they’re asking every single day.

As the Assistant Director, Client Engagement & Automation,
you will play a key role in transforming how EY engages prospects and clients, nurtures relationships, and drives meaningful business outcomes. Your expertise in marketing automation, client engagement, and data-driven customer experiences will be at the core of this role.

We’re seeking a leader who can lead a team of Marketo automation specialists, oversee marketing contact management strategy, enhance customer journeys, and develop scalable engagement programs that deliver measurable impact. Using marketing technology, data, and insights, you’ll create seamless, personalized experiences across digital channels and virtual and in-person events, while measuring engagement throughout the prospect and client lifecycle.

Beyond the day-to-day responsibilities, you'll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and customer experience. You'll bring curiosity, innovation, and a continuous improvement mindset to evolve how EY engages audiences and strengthen relationships. Success in this role will come from understanding how prospects and clients interact with our brand, identifying what drives engagement, and designing meaningful experiences that build trust and loyalty over time. Through your leadership, we'll better connect data, automation, content and experiences to deliver highly personalized journeys, improve marketing effectiveness, and elevate the impact of both virtual and in-person events.

If you're passionate about using technology, data, and automation to create exceptional client experiences and help shape the future of marketing engagement, we'd love to hear from you.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of Marketo automation specialists responsible for campaign execution and operational excellence.
Develop, implement and optimize engagement programs that nurture prospects and strengthen client relationships throughout the lifecycle.
Establish and oversee contact management strategies, ensuring data quality, segmentation standards, and compliance with privacy regulations.
Create personalized, multi-channel journeys that improve engagement, conversion, and client experience.
Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to assess campaign effectiveness and engagement trends.
Partner with marketing teams to deliver lead nurturing programs, scoring models, and pipeline acceleration initiatives.
Support virtual and in-person event strategies, including registration journeys, attendee communications, engagement tracking, and post-event follow-up.
Continuously evaluate and streamline marketing processes to improve scalability, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Serve as a key partner to stakeholders across the organization to align engagement strategies with business objectives.
Stay current on emerging trends, AI capabilities, and Martech solutions to drive continuous innovation and improvement.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Ability to think strategically and connect client engagement initiatives to broader business and growth objectives.
Deep expertise in marketing automation platforms, including campaign management, audience segmentation, lead nurturing, and reporting.
Strong understanding of customer journey mapping and experience design across digital and event touchpoints.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and leadership levels.
Excellent project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver complex initiatives.
Curiosity and a passion for innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and articulate business value.
Client-centric approach focused on delivering personalized, relevant, and impactful experiences that strengthen engagement and loyalty.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing or Business Administration
Proven Experience delivering cross-channel, demand generation campaigns for leading brands
Must have extensive hands on experience with Marketo or a similar automation tool
Strong hands on experience in media planning and buying with in-depth knowledge of search and programmatic advertising
In-depth knowledge of martech capabilities spanning platforms (Google, LinkedIn, Twitter, Marketo, email marketing, CRM, etc.), production (content marketing, SEM/PPC, marketing automation, SEO, benchmarking, media plan design, etc.) and measurement (analytics, dashboarding, reporting, etc.)
Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret complex data, uncover actionable insights, and connect findings to customer needs and business objectives

What We Offer

At EY, our Total Rewards package supports our commitment to creating a leading people culture built on high-performance teaming, where everyone can achieve their potential and contribute to building a better working world for our people, our clients and our communities. We offer a competitive compensation package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage, a defined contribution pension plan, a vacation policy, firm-paid days, statutory holidays and paid personal days based on province of residence, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

Toronto/London/Ottawa/Waterloo: $94,100 to $144,100
Dieppe: $84,800 to $134,800

new_jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Winning isn’t just about the close. It’s about how organizations experience our differentiated value proposition at the beginning and across the middle that will ultimately define our future success as a professional services firm. Getting there means delivering meaningful touchpoints in the right ways and at the right time to create distinctly personal content and joined-up experiences for clients and potential clients that help answer the big questions they’re asking every single day.

As the Assistant Director, Client Engagement & Automation,
you will play a key role in transforming how EY engages prospects and clients, nurtures relationships, and drives meaningful business outcomes. Your expertise in marketing automation, client engagement, and data-driven customer experiences will be at the core of this role.

We’re seeking a leader who can lead a team of Marketo automation specialists, oversee marketing contact management strategy, enhance customer journeys, and develop scalable engagement programs that deliver measurable impact. Using marketing technology, data, and insights, you’ll create seamless, personalized experiences across digital channels and virtual and in-person events, while measuring engagement throughout the prospect and client lifecycle.

Beyond the day-to-day responsibilities, you'll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and customer experience. You'll bring curiosity, innovation, and a continuous improvement mindset to evolve how EY engages audiences and strengthen relationships. Success in this role will come from understanding how prospects and clients interact with our brand, identifying what drives engagement, and designing meaningful experiences that build trust and loyalty over time. Through your leadership, we'll better connect data, automation, content and experiences to deliver highly personalized journeys, improve marketing effectiveness, and elevate the impact of both virtual and in-person events.

If you're passionate about using technology, data, and automation to create exceptional client experiences and help shape the future of marketing engagement, we'd love to hear from you.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of Marketo automation specialists responsible for campaign execution and operational excellence.
Develop, implement and optimize engagement programs that nurture prospects and strengthen client relationships throughout the lifecycle.
Establish and oversee contact management strategies, ensuring data quality, segmentation standards, and compliance with privacy regulations.
Create personalized, multi-channel journeys that improve engagement, conversion, and client experience.
Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to assess campaign effectiveness and engagement trends.
Partner with marketing teams to deliver lead nurturing programs, scoring models, and pipeline acceleration initiatives.
Support virtual and in-person event strategies, including registration journeys, attendee communications, engagement tracking, and post-event follow-up.
Continuously evaluate and streamline marketing processes to improve scalability, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Serve as a key partner to stakeholders across the organization to align engagement strategies with business objectives.
Stay current on emerging trends, AI capabilities, and Martech solutions to drive continuous innovation and improvement.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Ability to think strategically and connect client engagement initiatives to broader business and growth objectives.
Deep expertise in marketing automation platforms, including campaign management, audience segmentation, lead nurturing, and reporting.
Strong understanding of customer journey mapping and experience design across digital and event touchpoints.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and leadership levels.
Excellent project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver complex initiatives.
Curiosity and a passion for innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and articulate business value.
Client-centric approach focused on delivering personalized, relevant, and impactful experiences that strengthen engagement and loyalty.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing or Business Administration
Proven Experience delivering cross-channel, demand generation campaigns for leading brands
Must have extensive hands on experience with Marketo or a similar automation tool
Strong hands on experience in media planning and buying with in-depth knowledge of search and programmatic advertising
In-depth knowledge of martech capabilities spanning platforms (Google, LinkedIn, Twitter, Marketo, email marketing, CRM, etc.), production (content marketing, SEM/PPC, marketing automation, SEO, benchmarking, media plan design, etc.) and measurement (analytics, dashboarding, reporting, etc.)
Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret complex data, uncover actionable insights, and connect findings to customer needs and business objectives

What We Offer

At EY, our Total Rewards package supports our commitment to creating a leading people culture built on high-performance teaming, where everyone can achieve their potential and contribute to building a better working world for our people, our clients and our communities. We offer a competitive compensation package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage, a defined contribution pension plan, a vacation policy, firm-paid days, statutory holidays and paid personal days based on province of residence, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

Toronto/London/Ottawa/Waterloo: $94,100 to $144,100
Dieppe: $84,800 to $134,800

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work.
